name: B10-0249/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Return of Ukrainian children forcibly transferred and deported by Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the return of Ukrainian children forcibly transferred and deported by Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It condemns Russia for taking Ukrainian children to Russia, for "re-education" and for illegal adoption, and says these acts may be war crimes. It asks the European Union and its member states to pressure Russia to return all the children, to support the International Criminal Court's arrest warrants for President Putin and Russia's Children's Rights Commissioner, and to keep funding research into the deportations.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is the Parliament's opinion and set of requests, not a new law.
- **Who it affects:** Ukrainian children held in Russia, Russia's leadership, European Union governments, and the International Criminal Court.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union leaders, member state governments, Ukraine and Russia; member states are urged to act.
